answer: Each identity must post a bond of 500 units in escrow plus a hardware attestation keyed to one device, and the kernel rejects any registration lacking either. A detected sybil loses the full 500-unit bond, 100 percent slashed at epoch end, after a 30-epoch wait. Copying identities fails because each fake costs another 500 units, a shared raven penalty hits the whole cluster, and independent jurors flag duplicate attestations through a fable record.
